definitions.entity: Strict IOB2 span, counted once at B-. End index is exclusive.
definitions.surface: Exact tuple of original entity tokens; case-sensitive, no punctuation or whitespace normalization.
definitions.unseen_primary: Surface absent among ALL training gold entity types. Mention rate weights occurrences; unique rate weights distinct surfaces within each type.
definitions.unseen_typed: Surface absent from training gold entities of the SAME type; reported separately.
definitions.casefold: Supplemental case-insensitive comparison uses str.casefold() on each token; original data are unchanged.
definitions.capitalization: First character of the original first token is uppercase (str.isupper). Entity denominator: all mentions of that type. Sentence-O denominator: sentences whose token at index 0 has O; no punctuation skipping.
definitions.transition: Only adjacent tokens within a sentence; no transitions across sentences. Probability divides by outgoing transitions for that label. Zero denominator is null (N/A).
definitions.ambiguity: Exact token forms or complete entity surfaces with at least two distinct entity types WITHIN a split. O is excluded from entity types; O occurrence counts are supplemental.
definitions.vocabulary: Includes punctuation and digits. Directed source-to-target type coverage = intersection / target vocabulary size; token coverage weights target token occurrences. Jaccard = intersection / union.
definitions.top_entities: Top 10 per split and type, by mention count descending then token tuple ascending; plots show training entities.
definitions.paper_sentences: Compare HF sentences directly to 14041/3250/3453; also compare HF sentences + document count to paper sentence count. DOCSTART explanation is an inference, not a reconstruction of the original files.
definitions.test_use: Test statistics are descriptive only and must not select features, hyperparameters, preprocessing or models. No prediction scores are computed.
